what: Open-pr resume validates the git branch but persists ctx.branch_name/ctx.branch in _write_ship_state
scenario_or_breakage: _resume_plan can admit open-pr when git.try_current_branch and gh/state agree while RunContext still carries a stale or empty --branch; pre-CI writes then set BRANCH_NAME to the wrong value and later ship/finalize guards or a bash re-entry can fail despite a valid resume classification
suggested_fix: After branch validation succeeds, hydrate working with the probed branch (or matched state BRANCH_NAME) before any open-pr/merged _write_ship_state; add a test that stubs git head feat with mismatched ctx.branch and asserts state writes feat

what: Merged/postmerge stall still writes PHASE=done on the main CI success path
scenario_or_breakage: When run_postmerge_phase returns STALLED, the existing loop still calls _write_ship_state(phase="done"), which can contradict stall/finalize metadata (prior edge review); the plan only guards the new merged-resume branch
suggested_fix: On postmerge stall in the main loop, mirror the merged-resume rule: skip done writes and route through _write_terminal_state or equivalent stall-preserving path
